verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents first-party support for HIPAA (with a HIPAA-to-Unified-Control mapping and breach notification template), GDPR (added via its multi-framework approach), and PCI DSS (compliance automation plus ASV scans) in one platform. A unified control list maps all offered frameworks, so adding a framework reuses existing work rather than requiring a new tool. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor-claimed), and in-depth help-center documentation for GDPR and PCI DSS control mappings comparable to the HIPAA/SOC 2/HITRUST guides.

support.subject: As an operations lead, frameworks beyond SOC 2 and ISO — HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS — are supported from the same platform so new customer requirements don't mean a new tool
